entry.content: I'm shopping for a Maverick and I'm torn. I really want the hybrid powertrain and I also really want the towing package. But I also really want a used ~MY24 because the of the interior. Normally I'm not one to make a big deal about a touchscreen, I used to have a Tesla so I'm used to them, but the setup in the Maverick is pretty bad. It's not that the hvac and media are on the screen but that they're just done badly. I don't know if I should give up on the screen and get a MY25 hybrid with towin
